units: <cite ref="Chullin 131a:16">Ḥull. 131ᵃ</cite>, sq. <he>שלא תיטול תִּפְאַרְתּוֹ</he>, v. <cite ref="Q00024"><he>פָּאַר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:5:14">Y. Ber. I, 3ᵈ</cite> top <he>לך גדולה … לך ת׳</he> thine is the greatness, thine the power, thine the glory.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19">Lev. R. s. 19</cite> <he>בית קדשינו ותִפְאַרְתֵּנוּ</he> the house of our holiness and of our glory. Mekh. B’shall., s. 2 <he>ונותנין שיר ושבח … ות׳ וכ׳</he> and give song, and praise, and greatness, and glory to him &c. Ib. s. 1 <he>תִּפְאַרְתָּם</he> their (the Egyptians’) pride; a. e.
